title: Equivariant Deep Learning in Direct-Product Space for Electronic-Structure Hamiltonian Prediction
title_zh: 用于电子结构哈密顿预测的直接积空间中的等变量深度学习
summary: 大多数现有的汉密尔顿预测等变量架构在不可约球面张量的直和空间中传播特征，而目标汉密尔顿变量自然是局部轨道和自旋基的直接乘积表示中的算子块。这种表示不匹配分割了相邻的哈密顿块，模糊了轨道耦合的直接操作，并将特征组织成不规则的角动量组件，这些组件需要许多变换，并且与有效的硬件执行和内存管理不协调。为了解决表示不匹配和计算瓶颈，我们提出了DP-Learner ，这是一个等变学习框架，直接在直接乘积空间中的类汉密尔顿算子块上执行消息传递。
abstract: arXiv:2611.07695v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Most existing equivariant architectures for Hamiltonian prediction propagate features in direct-sum spaces of irreducible spherical tensors, whereas the target Hamiltonian is naturally an operator block in a direct-product representation over local orbital and spin bases. This representation mismatch fragments contiguous Hamiltonian blocks, obscures direct manipulation of orbital couplings, and organizes features into irregular angular-momentum components that require numerous transformations and are poorly aligned with efficient hardware execution and memory management. To address both the representation mismatch and computational bottleneck, we propose DP-Learner, an equivariant learning framework that performs message passing directly on Hamiltonian-like operator blocks in the direct-product space. Theoretically, we propose Lie-generator-based directional embedding and invariantly weighted left--right products and contractions that preserve equivariance to SO(3), SU(2), and spatial inversions, without explicit Clebsch--Gordan decomposition or inverse reconstruction. Methodologically, we instantiate this principle as a Transformer architecture, in which Hamiltonian-like feature matrices or tensors evolve through equivariant operators in the direct-product space, while non-linear invariant scalar routing controls structured gating over matrix units, directional propagation, attention, and environment-embedded context interactions. We further construct MP-HAM-110K, a large-scale Hamiltonian dataset comprising more than 110,000 material structures covering 68 elements with both Hamiltonian and wavefunction data. Experiments on MP-HAM-110K and Materials-HAM-SOC demonstrate that DP-Learner dramatically improves Hamiltonian prediction accuracy and inference efficiency over the state-of-the-art method.

title: Machine learning quantum data to accelerate quantum Monte Carlo
title_zh: 机器学习量子数据加速量子蒙特卡罗
summary: 模拟分子和材料中的强相关电子仍然是量子计算的核心目标。一种有前途的策略是使用量子处理器来准备引导经典量子蒙特卡罗（QMC）的试验波函数。然而，重复处理量子测量的巨大计算成本严重限制了这种方法的实际可扩展性。在这里，我们通过将量子测量数据压缩到机器学习模型中来克服这一瓶颈，该模型有效地提供 QMC 所需的波函数重叠。这将量子经典 QMC 加速了几个数量级，从而能够对多达 40 个量子位进行化学精确模拟，在具有相当精度的情况下，将之前硬件演示的规模扩大了一倍多。
abstract: arXiv:2611.08151v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Simulating strongly correlated electrons in molecules and materials remains a central goal for quantum computing. A promising strategy uses quantum processors to prepare trial wavefunctions that guide classical quantum Monte Carlo (QMC). However, the enormous computational cost of repeatedly processing quantum measurements has severely limited the practical scalability of this approach. Here, we overcome this bottleneck by compressing quantum measurement data into machine-learning models that efficiently provide the wavefunction overlaps needed by QMC. This accelerates quantum-classical QMC by orders of magnitude, enabling chemically accurate simulations on up to 40 qubits, more than doubling the scale of previous hardware demonstrations with comparable accuracy. We demonstrate our approach on hydrogen chains and strongly correlated iron-sulfur clusters using measurements from Google's Willow processor. By enabling efficient reuse of quantum-state information on the classical coprocessor, our framework addresses a fundamental bottleneck in hybrid quantum algorithms that will persist even into the fault-tolerant era.

title: Spectral symmetry fingerprints in equivariant representations
title_zh: 等变量表示中的光谱对称指纹
summary: 对称性支配着物理结构的组织，而对称性的破坏揭示了它们的转换。在几何深度学习中，对称性对等变量表示施加了秩约束，限制了等变量图神经网络（ GNN ）的表达能力。在这里，我们表明这些约束可以被利用：等变表示的奇异值谱提供了结构对称的统一指纹。我们引入了光谱对称指纹（ SymFP ） ，通过等级模板匹配和连续对称分析，通过量化超出目标等级约束的光谱能量，实现离散点群识别。SymFP是定向不变的，与架构无关，实现了无参数的GNN实现。
abstract: arXiv:2611.07410v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Symmetry governs the organization of physical structures, while symmetry breaking reveals their transformations. In geometric deep learning, symmetry imposes rank constraints on equivariant representations, limiting the expressive capacity of equivariant graph neural networks (GNNs). Here we show that these constraints can instead be exploited: the singular-value spectra of equivariant representations provide a unified fingerprint of structural symmetry. We introduce spectral symmetry fingerprints (SymFP), which enable discrete point-group identification through rank-template matching and continuous symmetry analysis by quantifying spectral energy beyond target rank constraints. SymFP is orientation invariant and architecture agnostic, enabling a parameter-free GNN implementation. Its spectra can be reused across multiple target groups, and the resulting leakage scores satisfy subgroup monotonicity. Across synthetic structures, molecules, coordination complexes and large biological assemblies, SymFP accurately identifies point groups, tracks controlled symmetry breaking and reveals local and degree-resolved symmetry changes that can be obscured by global geometric measures. These results establish the spectral structure of equivariant representations as a general framework for characterizing symmetry across physical systems.

title: Cup and Cap Topological Neural Network
title_zh: 杯盖拓扑神经网络
summary: 拓扑深度学习 (TDL) 旨在学习不仅与节点相关的特征，还可以学习与边、三角形和高维单纯形相关的特征。然而，大多数基于边界算子和霍奇拉普拉斯算子的 TDL 方法都存在局限性，即特征和信号不能在每层超过一个维度上提升或降低。为了克服这个限制，在这项工作中，我们建议采用杯子和盖子产品。具体来说，我们制定了 Cup and Cap 拓扑神经网络（CCNN），这是一种拓扑深度学习架构，旨在通过考虑数据中存在的多体交互（例如三角形）来学习基于节点的变量（或 0-cochains）。
abstract: arXiv:2610.03169v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological Deep Learning (TDL) is designed to learn features associated not only with nodes but also with edges, triangles and higher dimensional simplices. However, most TDL approaches, being based on boundary operators and Hodge Laplacians, have the limitation that features and signals cannot be lifted or lowered across more than one dimension per layer. To overcome this limitation, in this work, we propose the adoption of the cup and cap products. Specifically, we formulate the Cup and Cap Topological Neural Network (CCNN), a topological deep learning architecture designed to learn node-based variables (or 0-cochains) by taking into account their many-body interactions (e.g. triangles) present in the data. We validate CCNN by assessing its performance on the TopoBench datasets, demonstrating its competitive performance with respect to other simplicial complex neural networks.

title: Machine learning classification of dynamical phases in a driven nonlinear Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattice
title_zh: 驱动非线性 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 晶格中动态相的机器学习分类
summary: 驱动的非线性光子晶格可以进入稳定、对称破缺、周期性或混沌状态，并且映射每种状态在参数空间中出现的位置是器件设计的关键。暴力映射速度很慢，并且依赖于手工构建的标准，而机器学习分类器通常在不同的系统上进行测试，因此尚不清楚哪个适合新的网格。
abstract: arXiv:2611.08287v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Driven nonlinear photonic lattices can settle into steady, symmetry-broken, periodic, or chaotic states, and mapping where each occurs in parameter space is key to device design. Brute-force mapping is slow and relies on hand-built criteria, while machine-learning classifiers are usually tested on different systems, so it is unclear which suits a new lattice. We therefore apply four classifiers to the same coherently driven Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain of Kerr resonators: a hand-built heuristic classifier based on Lyapunov exponents and spectral diagnostics, a supervised convolutional neural network (CNN) trained on the heuristic labels, an unsupervised library-building scheme based on augmented dynamic mode decomposition (aDMD), and an unsupervised Gaussian mixture model (GMM) on four dynamical invariants that include an aDMD reconstruction error. Using a converged heuristic diagram as the reference, the CNN reaches 98.0% held-out accuracy, while the two label-free methods reach adjusted Rand indices (ARIs) of 0.916 and 0.947, respectively, without seeing any labels. We show that the aDMD library cleanly resolves the stable and bistable phases and separates symmetric from symmetry-broken periodic oscillations, which the heuristic misses, though it cannot distinguish periodic from chaotic switching. We also find that a poorly converged reference understates the label-free methods' accuracy.

title: Edge-enhanced diffractive neural networks based on spin-multiplexed nonlocal metasurfaces
title_zh: 基于自旋复用非局域超表面的边缘增强衍射神经网络
summary: 作者：何倩倩、郭克南、邱居民、邱惠福、肖书媛和刘婷婷 由于波前调制能力有限，单层衍射神经网络经常面临分类精度瓶颈。边缘检测作为一种光学图像处理技术，可以提取图像轮廓，并为简化分类任务提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，整合...... [物理。 Rev. Applied 26, 054019] 2026 年 11 月 6 日星期五发布
abstract: Author(s): Qianqian He, Kenan Guo, Jumin Qiu, Huifu Qiu, Shuyuan Xiao, and Tingting Liu Single-layer diffractive neural networks often face classification accuracy bottlenecks due to limited wavefront modulation capabilities. Edge detection, as an optical image processing technique, extracts image contours and offers a promising way to simplify classification tasks. However, integratin… [Phys. Rev. Applied 26, 054019] Published Fri Nov 06, 2026

title: Ab initio simulation of excited-state potential energy surfaces with transferable deep quantum Monte Carlo
title_zh: 利用可转移深量子蒙特卡罗从头开始模拟激发态势能面
summary: 介绍了分子激发态的可转移深度学习量子蒙特卡罗。 ansatz 共享参数，代表分子几何形状和状态的波函数，从而降低了势能表面建模的成本。
abstract: Nature Computational Science, Published online: 06 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01065-y Transferable deep-learning quantum Monte Carlo for molecular excited states is introduced. Sharing parameters, an ansatz represents the wavefunction across molecular geometries and states, reducing the cost of modeling potential energy surfaces.

title: Sparse Statistical Modeling in Condensed Matter Physics
title_zh: 凝聚态物理中的稀疏统计建模
summary: 在这项工作中，我们探索在凝聚态物理中使用稀疏统计模型的可能性。该过程用于解决两个众所周知的问题：元素超导体和重费米子，并且结果表明，在大多数情况下，其性能优于其他人工智能方法，例如机器或深度学习。更重要的是，稀疏建模比其他方法有两大优势：处理小数据集的能力，特别是其可解释性。也就是说，稀疏建模可以深入了解计算过程，并允许用户对其结果进行物理解释。我们认为凝聚态物理中的许多其他问题将受益于稀疏统计模型的这些特性。
abstract: arXiv:2601.14184v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work we explore the possibility of using sparse statistical modeling in condensed matter physics. The procedure is employed to two well known problems: elemental superconductors and heavy fermions, and was shown that in most cases performs better than other AI methods, such as machine or deep learning. More importantly, sparse modeling has two major advantages over other methods: the ability to deal with small data sets and in particular its interpretabilty. Namely, sparse modeling can provide insight into the calculation process and allow the users to give physical interpretation of their results. We argue that many other problems in condensed matter physics would benefit from these properties of sparse statistical modeling.

title: Synaptic Multi-Weight Wafer-Scale Domain Wall Magnetic Tunnel Junctions Driven by Spin Orbit Torque
title_zh: 自旋轨道扭矩驱动的突触多重量晶圆级畴壁磁隧道结
summary: 基于磁性随机存取存储器 (MRAM) 的自旋电子突触设备是模拟神经形态架构中快速发展的一类。然而，在缩放 MRAM 中获得提高神经网络推理精度所需的多权重或模拟行为仍然是一个挑战。在这项研究中，我们展示并调整了由自旋轨道扭矩驱动的 300 毫米晶圆级磁性隧道结人工突触中多达八个不同的电阻水平。通过改变所施加的面内场，通过磁畴壁成核和钉扎出现多重量电阻状态。这些多权重状态随机出现，并且可以通过迭代编程算法来解决，以对特定电阻进行编程。
abstract: arXiv:2611.08405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spintronic synaptic devices based on magnetic random access memory (MRAM) are a rapidly evolving class within the analog neuromorphic architecture. However, obtaining the multi-weight or analog behavior desired for improved neural network inference accuracy in scaled MRAM remains a challenge. In this study, we demonstrate and tune up to eight distinct resistance levels in 300 mm wafer-scale magnetic tunnel junction artificial synapses driven by spin orbit torque. By varying the applied in-plane field, multi-weight resistance states emerge through domain wall nucleation and pinning. These multi-weight states appear stochastically and can be addressed with an iterative programming algorithm to program a specific resistance. Electromagnetic simulations indicate the multiple states are due to domain wall nucleation mediated by in-plane field and applied voltage. Implementation of the measured multi-weight devices in a neural network yields a 96.1% inference accuracy using the MNIST dataset if all devices provide the same number of multi-weight states. When experimental device-to-device variation is included, the accuracy is 48.6%. Overall, this work demonstrates a route towards multi-weight artificial synapse MRAM, establishing a path towards scalable neuromorphic systems based on spintronics.

title: The lattice Boltzmann machine
title_zh: 格子玻尔兹曼机
summary: 格子玻尔兹曼 (LB) 方法被广泛认为是一种非常灵活且高效的求解器，适用于流体、软物质及相关领域中的广泛输运现象。在本文中，我们认为这种灵活性是其作为规则驱动的信息处理机器的生成性质的直接结果。它的更新是向局部目标松弛，然后沿着晶格移动，与残差网络和变压器属于同一类迭代松弛动力学，不同之处在于 LB 中的算子是通过守恒和对称性固定的，而不是从数据中学习。我们证明，这种更新的三个属性足以促进从底层迭代过程中出现封闭的宏观定律，目标的物理内容决定所讨论的具体定律。
abstract: arXiv:2611.07139v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The lattice Boltzmann (LB) method is widely regarded as a very flexible and efficient solver for a broad class of transport phenomena in fluids, soft matter and related fields. In this paper, we posit that such flexibility is a direct result of its generative nature as a rule-driven information-processing machine. Its update, a relaxation toward a local target followed by a shift along the lattice, belongs to the same class of iterated relaxation dynamics as residual networks and transformers, with the difference that in LB the operators are fixed by conservation and symmetry rather than learned from data. We show that three properties of this update are sufficient to promote the emergence of closed macroscopic laws from the underlying iteration process, the physical content of the target deciding the specific law in question. A machine whose target is drawn at random generates the transport law predicted from its moments. A network given the same three properties on a graph, where there is no lattice, is trained on a traffic process and generates a conservation law of its own. The mechanism has a precise limit, where the damping of the non-conserved modes fails, and on the lattice the macroscopic law gives no warning of it. In this reading, LB is a lattice Boltzmann machine whose informing rules are supplied by physics rather than by training. Its three properties then state what a new ingredient should preserve when it enters an LB model, whether it comes from physics or from data.

title: Masked diffusion as random sequential adsorption: an exactly solvable model for parallel decoding
title_zh: 作为随机顺序吸附的掩蔽扩散：并行解码的精确可解模型
summary: 掩蔽扩散模型通过反转随机掩蔽过程来生成文本。与每次生成一个标记的文本的自回归 LLM 不同，它们可以并行显示许多标记，但会出现错误，因为一起显示的标记是独立绘制的。我们证明这种权衡映射到驱动多粒子系统的统计物理上。 (i) 对于任何数据，并行生成的误差是生成过程相对于反向掩蔽过程的熵产生。 (ii) 对于马尔可夫数据，生成是带有标记间隙的随机顺序吸附过程，我们可以精确地求解任意数量的步骤。
abstract: arXiv:2611.07845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Masked diffusion models generate text by reversing a stochastic masking process. Unlike autoregressive LLMs, which generate text one token at a time, they can reveal many tokens in parallel, at the price of an error, since tokens revealed together are drawn independently. We show that this trade-off maps onto the statistical physics of driven many-particle systems. (i) For any data, the error of parallel generation is the entropy production of the generation process relative to the reversed masking process. (ii) For Markov data, generation is a random sequential adsorption process with labelled gaps, which we solve exactly for any number of steps. (iii) For many steps, the error becomes the dissipation of a slowly driven system: the unmasking schedule plays the role of the driving protocol, the number of steps that of its duration, and the error is set by a thermodynamic metric that we obtain in closed form from the mutual information between tokens. Optimal schedules are geodesics of this metric. The exact solution shows how correlations in the text shape both the error and the quality of the output. The longer the correlations, the more the error concentrates at the start of generation. Schedules that start with small steps then gain more, both in path error and in perplexity, and need fewer steps to reach their asymptotic behaviour.

title: Towards Multiscale Molecular Representation Learning through Geometry-Based Fragmentation for Polymer Property Prediction
title_zh: 基于几何碎片的多尺度分子表示学习用于聚合物性质预测
summary: 众所周知，分子亚结构对化学和物理性质的贡献不均匀，特定基序或侧链通常起主导作用。因此，基于片段的表示已成为整合化学上有意义的诱导偏差的有效策略，例如分子指纹和基于片段的注意机制。然而，许多现有的基于碎片的机器学习方法依赖于预定义的化学规则，这对于以前看不见的或化学上不熟悉的结构可能产生次优的碎片，并且经常忽略多尺度分子表示的重要性。
abstract: arXiv:2611.07998v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: It is well established that molecular substructures can contribute unequally to chemical and physical properties, with specific motifs or side chains often playing dominant roles. Fragment-based representations have therefore emerged as an effective strategy for incorporating chemically meaningful inductive biases, as exemplified by molecular fingerprints and fragment-based attention mechanisms. However, many existing fragmentation-based machine learning methods rely on predefined chemical rules, which may yield suboptimal fragmentation for previously unseen or chemically unfamiliar structures and often overlook the importance of multiscale molecular representations. To address these limitations, we formulate molecular fragmentation as a radius-constrained optimization problem inspired by the k-center formulation, where the number of clusters is not fixed a priori but emerges from the specified radius, and propose a geometry-based fragmentation method that partitions arbitrary molecular or material structures using largely geometric information, without relying on predefined chemical fragmentation rules. The method provides flexible control over fragment size, enabling the construction of multiscale fragment representations for scale-adaptive modeling. Building on this framework, we develop a geometric fragment-based attention mechanism that integrates multiscale structural information and incorporate it into a multimodal machine learning model combining p-SMILES representations with three-dimensional (3D) conformational information. Experiments on a benchmark polymer dataset show that incorporating 3D conformational information improves prediction accuracy for several properties over models based exclusively on p-SMILES representations. Explainable artificial intelligence analyses further provide insights into the physical relevance of the learned representations.

title: Experimental Evidence for Type-I Superconductivity in OsB₂
title_zh: OsB2 中 I 型超导性的实验证据
summary: 自从发现 MgB2 超导性以来，金属二硼化物引起了人们的广泛关注。其中，二硼化锇（OsB2）结晶为具有褶皱硼层的斜方结构（空间群Pmmn），被归类为低κII型超导体（T_c约2.1~K）。在这里，我们报告了实验证据，证明 OsB2 实际上是一种罕见的非元素 I 型超导体。我们的鉴定得到了三个主要实验标志的支持：（i）在静态直流磁场下的交流磁化率（χₐc）测量中存在明显的微分顺磁效应（DPE）峰值，表明中间状态； (ii) 场诱导交叉到比热 (C/T) 发散的一级相变；
abstract: arXiv:2611.08239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Since the discovery of superconductivity in MgB₂, metal diborides have attracted significant attention. Among these, osmium diboride (OsB₂), crystallizing in an orthorhombic structure (space group Pmmn) with puckered boron layers, has been classified as a low-κ Type-II superconductor (T_c approx 2.1~K). Here, we report experimental evidence establishing that OsB₂ is in fact a rare nonelemental Type-I superconductor. Our identification is supported by three primary experimental hallmarks: (i) a pronounced Differential Paramagnetic Effect (DPE) peak in AC susceptibility (χₐc) measurements under static DC magnetic fields, signaling the intermediate state; (ii) a field-induced crossover to a divergent first-order phase transition in specific heat (C/T); and (iii) pronounced magnetic hysteresis in field-ramped transitions indicative of supercooling.

title: Unifying Dirac Spin Liquids on Square and Shastry-Sutherland Lattices via Fermionic Deconfined Criticality
title_zh: 通过费米子解域临界统一方格和 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上的狄拉克自旋液体
summary: 我们提出了一种费米子规范理论，用于解禁 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上的量子临界点，并揭示了其与方晶格共享的低能场论结构。从 SU(2) π 通量母态开始，我们构建了耦合到 SU(2) 规范场和伴随希格斯场的狄拉克自旋子的连续介质理论，其凝聚驱动转变为交错通量 U(1) 自旋液体和无间隙 Z2 狄拉克自旋液体。虽然与方晶格相比，Shastry-Sutherland 晶格允许额外的对称性费米子双线性，但量子场论在附加不相关项之前是相同的。
abstract: arXiv:2601.19980v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a fermionic gauge theory for deconfined quantum criticality on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice and reveal its shared low-energy field-theoretic structure with the square lattice. Starting from an SU(2) π-flux parent state, we construct a continuum theory of Dirac spinons coupled to an SU(2) gauge field and adjoint Higgs fields whose condensates drive transitions to a staggered-flux U(1) spin liquid and a gapless Z₂ Dirac spin liquid. While the Shastry-Sutherland lattice permits additional symmetry-allowed fermion bilinears compared to the square lattice, the quantum field theories are identical up to additional irrelevant terms. Consequently, the Higgs potential structure and the leading low-energy theory coincide with the square-lattice case at the quantum critical point. The SO(5) critical point is expected to realize conformal deconfined criticality: we analyze it in a large-flavor expansion, calculate its critical exponents, and identify the Yukawa coupling between the fermions and Higgs fields as the relevant perturbation that destabilizes it, consistent with pseudocritical behavior observed in recent Monte Carlo studies. We show that the emergent SO(5) order parameter acquires a large anomalous dimension at the critical point, leading to strongly enhanced Néel and VBS susceptibilities-a hallmark of fermionic deconfined quantum criticality consistent with numerical studies. Our results place recent numerical evidence for a gapless Z₂ Dirac spin liquid on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice within a controlled field-theoretic framework and demonstrate that fermionic deconfined criticality on the square lattice-including critical exponents and stability-extends to frustrated lattices with reduced symmetry.

title: Graph Symbolic Distillation: Decoding Graph Data into Interpretable Formulas across Materials and Chemistry
title_zh: 图符号蒸馏：将图数据解码为跨材料和化学的可解释公式
summary: 图形数据提供了许多化学和材料系统背后的互连结构和相互作用的自然表示。图神经网络（GNN）可以从这些数据中学习复杂的关系，但将这些表示转化为可解释的描述符和科学见解仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍图符号蒸馏（GSD），一个用于将图数据解码为可解释的符号公式的框架。 GSD 识别与任务相关的消息传递架构，并提取其学习到的转换，同时保留图连接和聚合操作。
abstract: arXiv:2611.07719v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph data provide a natural representation of the interconnected structures and interactions underlying many chemical and materials systems. Graph neural networks (GNNs) can learn complex relationships from such data, yet translating these representations into interpretable descriptors and scientific insights remains challenging. Here we introduce graph symbolic distillation (GSD), a framework for decoding graph data into interpretable symbolic formulas. GSD identifies task-relevant message-passing architectures and distills their learned transformations while preserving graph connectivity and aggregation operations. Across three case studies spanning bulk materials, molecules, and surfaces, GSD not only recovers expert-defined descriptors from elementary node and edge features, but also reveals relationships emerging from their organization in complex graphs: extremal local geometric descriptors for band gap variations in γ-CsPbI₃, a local polarity--size relationship underlying hydration free energy, and site-specific electronic--connectivity coupling in multidentate adsorption. GSD thus provides a general route from graph data to interpretable descriptors and new, testable scientific insights.

title: An Agent-Driven, Cross-Validated Inverse-Design Pipeline for Dielectric Metasurfaces
title_zh: 用于介电超表面的代理驱动、交叉验证的逆向设计流程
summary: 介电超表面的逆向设计功能强大，但劳动密集型：每个新目标都需要选择参数化和品质因数、管理计算资源，并严格评估可能在数值上不收敛、对制造误差敏感或陷入局部最优的结果。在这里，我们提出了一个开源管道，其中人工智能（AI）编码代理将简单语言规范转换为超表面优化运行，执行它们，使用固定清单分析每次运行并提出下一次迭代。通过可微分三维严格耦合波分析 (RCWA) 优化设计，包括制造公差的鲁棒性，并且每个报告的设计都通过有限差分时域 (FDTD) 仿真进行独立验证。
abstract: arXiv:2611.08127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inverse design of dielectric metasurfaces is powerful but labour-intensive: each new target requires choosing a parameterization and a figure of merit, managing compute resources, and critically assessing results that may be numerically unconverged, sensitive to fabrication errors or trapped in local optima. Here we present an open-source pipeline in which an artificial intelligence (AI) coding agent turns a plain-language specification into metasurface optimization runs, executes them, analyses every run with a fixed checklist and proposes the next iteration. Designs are optimized with differentiable three-dimensional rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA), including robustness to fabrication tolerances, and every reported design is independently verified with finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations. We demonstrate the workflow at 1550 nm on a freeform silicon metagrating, on a polarization-independent meta-atom library assembled into beam-deflecting supercells, and on metalenses built from the same library. In the metagrating case, the independent FDTD verification revealed a 5% overestimate of the efficiency by the optimization model that a conventional convergence test had not detected, and the robust design retained most of its efficiency under ±10~nm fabrication errors. In the other cases, instead, the obtained RCWA results are confirmed by full-wave simulations.

title: Ferroelectric control of magnetic coupling in a Cr dimer adsorbed on α-In₂Se₃
title_zh: α-In2Se₃ 上吸附的 Cr 二聚体磁耦合的铁电控制
summary: 铁电基板提供了一种通过局部键合和电子结构中极化相关的变化来控制低维系统中磁相互作用的途径。在这里，我们利用第一性原理计算，研究了 3d 过渡金属原子和二聚体在单层 α-In2Se3 上的吸附，并将 Cr 确定为两个极性表面上的稳定二聚体构型。反转铁电极化会导致其磁耦合发生显着变化：一种极化有利于 AFM 状态，而相反的极化则使 FM 和 AFM 配置几乎退化。对自旋密度、投影电子态和万尼尔哈密顿量的分析揭示了直接 Cr-Cr 跳跃以及与桥接 Se 原子相互作用的伴随变化。
abstract: arXiv:2611.08055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric substrates offer a route to controlling magnetic interactions in low-dimensional systems through polarization-dependent changes in local bonding and electronic structure. Here, using first-principles calculations, we investigate the adsorption of 3d transition-metal atoms and dimers on monolayer α-In₂Se₃ and identify Cr as a stable dimer configuration on both polar surfaces. Reversing the ferroelectric polarization drives a pronounced change in its magnetic coupling: the AFM state is favored for one polarization, whereas the FM and AFM configurations become nearly degenerate for the opposite one. Analysis of the spin density, projected electronic states, and Wannier Hamiltonians reveals concomitant changes in the direct Cr-Cr hopping and in the interaction with the bridging Se atom. In particular, enhanced Cr-Se hybridization and Se spin polarization, together with a strong reduction of the direct two-center Cr-Cr hopping, point to a polarization-dependent balance between direct and substrate-mediated exchange contributions. These results show how ferroelectric polarization can tune magnetic interactions in an atomically defined 2D hybrid system.

title: Key role of orbital exchange in CoO magnetism
title_zh: 轨道交换在 CoO 磁性中的关键作用
summary: 众所周知，CoO 反铁磁相中的 Co 离子拥有相当大的轨道矩，使这种材料有望用于轨道电子学应用。然而，涉及这些轨道自由度的位点间交换相互作用仍然很少被量化，并且它们在 CoO 磁性中的作用尚不清楚。在这里，我们使用基于 DFT+动态平均场理论的从头算力定理方法推导了 CoO 的完整低能有效哈密顿量，包括轨道交换项。我们发现了相当大的轨道相互作用，其中四极轨道交换成为主要的最近邻项。
abstract: arXiv:2611.08065v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Co ions in the antiferromagnetic phase of CoO are known to possess a substantial orbital moment, making this material promising for orbitronic applications. However, intersite exchange interactions involving these orbital degrees of freedom remain poorly quantified, and their role in CoO magnetism is unclear. Here, we derive a full low-energy effective Hamiltonian for CoO, including orbital exchange terms, using an ab initio force-theorem approach based on DFT+dynamical mean-field theory. We find sizable orbital interactions, with quadrupolar orbital exchange emerging as the dominant nearest-neighbor term. The collinear antiferromagnetic order obtained from the effective Hamiltonian features magnetic moments tilted away from the pseudocubic <001> direction and an orbital contribution amounting to about one-third of the total moment, in agreement with experimental estimates. We show that the moment tilting originates from the combined effect of orbital and spin-orbital exchange interactions. The same interactions also produce a prominent splitting of the lowest excitation band. By directly modeling the inelastic neutron scattering (INS) intensity, we further show that the characteristic column-like structures previously observed in CoO INS provide a clear fingerprint of orbital exchange. We also discuss possible impact of our findings for further advances in the field of complex collective excitations, their transport properties and applications in the realm of orbitronics.

title: Negligible Kitaev interaction in the van der Waals antiferromagnet NiBr₂ revealed by neutron spectroscopy
title_zh: 中子能谱揭示范德华反铁磁体 NiBr2 中可忽略不计的基塔耶夫相互作用
summary: 使用飞行时间中子光谱，我们绘制了范德华反铁磁体 NiBr2 在广泛的能量和动量范围内的磁激发。观察到的明确定义的磁振子色散通过基于最小双线性哈密顿量的线性自旋波理论定量再现，其中包括高达第三最近邻的海森堡交换相互作用、层间耦合和单离子各向异性项，而无需调用基塔耶夫相互作用。这一发现与溴比碘轻的事实相一致，导致 NiBr2 中配体介导的自旋轨道耦合比 NiI2 弱，从而减少了 Kitaev 相互作用。
abstract: arXiv:2611.07597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using time-of-flight neutron spectroscopy, we have mapped out the magnetic excitations in the van der Waals antiferromagnet NiBr₂ over a broad range of energies and momenta. The observed well-defined magnon dispersions are quantitatively reproduced by linear spin-wave theory based on a minimal bilinear Hamiltonian that includes Heisenberg exchange interactions up to third-nearest neighbors, interlayer couplings, and a single-ion anisotropy term, with no need to invoke a Kitaev interaction. This finding is consistent with the fact that bromine is lighter than iodine, leading to weaker ligand-mediated spin-orbit coupling in NiBr2 than in NiI2, and consequently a reduced Kitaev interaction. Our results establish NiBr₂ as a Heisenberg-dominated van der Waals antiferromagnet and support the view that the ligand spin-orbit coupling governs the strength of the bond-dependent interactions within the NiX₂ (X = halogen) family.

title: A MACE interatomic potential for two dimensional and curved sp 2 carbon: family level transfer benchmarks and a SOAP based structural novelty map
title_zh: 二维和弯曲 sp 2 碳的 MACE 原子间势：族级转移基准和基于 SOAP 的结构新颖图
summary: 出版日期：2027 年 1 月 资料来源：Computational Materials Science，第 276 卷 作者：Yunus Emre Okyayli、Dilara Ickecan、Dogan Erbahar
